shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.summary: Six classes · three maps · slide hopping · AI battles

variants.title: Keep moving. Find your angle.
variants.copy: A block-world FPS with jump-and-slide momentum, six weapon classes and three original maps. Every corner changes the fight.

variants.title: Pick a class. Make your shot.
variants.copy: Assault, Hunter, Runner, Breacher, Heavy and Marksman. Headshots, reloads, recoil, cover and quick respawns.

variants.title: Your map. Your rules.
variants.copy: Free for all, team deathmatch and rotating hardpoint. Three AI levels, Random settings and a practice range.

variants.title: Two thumbs. One crosshair.
variants.copy: Large independent movement, look and fire controls. Mouse lock, drag aiming, keyboard and saved match statistics.

features: Movement wins fights
Jump, slide, carry momentum and use cover. Original block maps, six classes and headshot combat.
Set up the match
Free for all, team deathmatch or hardpoint against three AI difficulties. Random options and a training range.
Make it yours
Mouse, keyboard and big touch controls. Weapon colours, XP, career saves and three downloadable mods.
mods: Lower gravity makes jumps longer for every combatant.
Unlimited loaded ammunition for both sides; weapon fire rates still apply.
All combatants move 35% faster, including jumps and sliding approaches.

matchsurvival.name: Match Survival
matchsurvival.summary: Build by day · survive the night · cascades and bosses

variants.title: Grid- Match- Survive
variants.copy: Match three to gather resources and build a village. When night falls, the very same tiles become weapons, shields and creatures.

variants.title: A village by day. A fight by night.
variants.copy: Daylight advances with your swaps. Night runs in real time. Equip your survivor and choose your battles.

variants.title: Six workshops. One survivor.
variants.copy: Upgrade your homestead, forge, sawmill, brickworks, weaver and arcane tower. Every new resource changes the grid.

variants.title: Face the fifth-night creatures.
variants.copy: Boss nights, magic, potions, bombs and resumable expeditions. Survive 25 nights, then keep exploring endlessly.

features: Make every match matter
Swap, cascade, collect and construct. Daylight lasts twelve successful moves.
Hold the night
Wood becomes shields, stone becomes swords and other resources summon creatures.
Your little world
Animated original village art, three difficulties, resumable progress and three mods.
mods: Daytime matches gather twice as many resources.
Nights last 100 seconds, giving more time to fight and collect magic.
Swords deal 80% more damage per equipment charge.

subwaysurfers.name: Subway Surfers
subwaysurfers.summary: Three lanes · rooftops · hoverboards · four original worlds
subwaysurfers.controls: Swipe · arrow keys · big touch buttons

variants.title: Run free. Stay ahead.
variants.copy: Weave around trains, jump barriers, roll under signs and take the rooftops. One more corner becomes your next best run.

variants.title: Metro. Coast. Neon. Garden.
variants.copy: Four original cities, changing world-tour scenery, oncoming trains and seeded fair routes. Swipe, keys and large touch controls.

variants.title: Grab a board. Take the roofs.
variants.copy: Hoverboards absorb one crash. Magnets, jetpacks, sneakers and score boosts turn a tricky escape into a great run.

variants.title: A crew of your own.
variants.copy: Unlock four outfits and three boards, upgrade power-ups, complete missions and beat your daily route record. No ads or purchases.

features: Fast, fair and endless
Seeded obstacle rows, gradual speed, ramps, train roofs, jumps, rolls and a pursuing guard.
Collect and progress
Four power-ups, hoverboards, key continuation, earned cosmetics, mission multipliers and daily personal records.
Run anywhere
Offline perspective art, keyboard, swipe and big touch controls. Three native downloadable mods.
mods: Collect nearby coins across every lane for the entire run.
Lower gravity makes jumps last longer, including rooftop approaches.
Run 30% faster; course spacing scales with your speed.

avengefps.name: Avenge FPS
avengefps.summary: Four heroes · eight weapons · spells · four objective modes
avengefps.controls: WASD · mouse · hero abilities · big touch controls

variants.title: Abilities change everything.
variants.copy: Four heroes with grenades, shurikens, axes, grapples, dashes and totem traps. Build your spell deck during each match.

variants.title: Own the ring. Bank the coins.
variants.copy: Point control, Black Coin, Gun Game and a three-versus-three cart escort. Four original arenas and three AI levels.

variants.title: One card. A different fight.
variants.copy: Earn tier XP, pause to select a card, and imbue your hero ability with frost, venom, shock or other effects.

variants.title: Your thumbs are welcome.
variants.copy: Large independent touch controls, drag or locked mouse aiming, eight weapon choices and a no-stakes practice range.

features: Heroes with character
Four ability pairs, bouncing grenades, trap totems, grappling and wall-safe dashing.
A match worth playing
Four objective modes, original maps, weapon progression, AI rivals and spell cards.
Play your way
Keyboard, mouse and large touch controls. Career XP, local saves and three native mods.
mods: Lower gravity increases airtime for every hero.
Weapons never run out of loaded ammunition. Both sides keep normal fire rates.
Both hero abilities have half their normal cooldown.

footyphysics.name: Footy Physics
footyphysics.summary: Floppy legs · first to five · random rounds · couch multiplayer
footyphysics.controls: Up / W · separate Left–Right / A–D · big touch buttons

variants.title: Jump. Flop. Somehow score.
variants.copy: Floppy teammates, swinging legs and a real bouncing ball. First to five wins.

variants.title: Slippery business. Moon league.
variants.copy: Eight round twists change the ground, gravity, player size, ball or goals after every score.

variants.title: One device. Four players.
variants.copy: Solo AI or local multiplayer. Control your whole team, or share the separate-player buttons with friends.

variants.title: A team of your own.
variants.copy: Earn six cosmetic kits, track wins and streaks, practise physics and try three downloadable mods.

features: Actual floppy physics
Hinged legs, rotating bodies, angular collision impulses and a bouncing ball.
Couch chaos
One-button or separate-player input, solo AI, two- and four-player local games, eight random round twists.
Big buttons, little legends
Touch and keyboard, earned cosmetic kits, saved career records, practice and three native mods.
mods: Every pitch has low gravity and longer airtime.
Increase the real ball collision radius by 80%.
Jump and forward impulses are 35% stronger.

swarmsim.name: Swarm Sim
swarmsim.summary: 20 producer tiers · 11 army tiers · energy abilities · ascension
swarmsim.controls: Tap to hatch · quantity selector · keyboard sections

variants.kicker: A LITTLE COLONY. A BIG WORLD.
variants.title: From three drones to a hive mind.
variants.copy: Start with meat and larvae. Hatch queens, nests and twenty producer tiers while an original animated colony grows.

variants.title: Sacrifice. Regrow. Multiply.
variants.copy: Queens consume drones and then make new drones. Plan purchases, build hatcheries, expand territory and buy twin upgrades.

variants.title: Rush. Clone. Warp. Ascend.
variants.copy: Five nexus, six energy abilities, eleven troop tiers and ten permanent mutations. Spend energy to lower the cost of the next world.

variants.title: Close the tab. Come back stronger.
variants.copy: Analytic offline catch-up, readable huge numbers, purchase undo, backup import/export, touch-friendly controls and three native mods.

features: Keep the producer chain growing
Twenty meat tiers, eleven military tiers, creature sacrifices, twin upgrades, hatcheries and expansions.
A new world remembers
Energy storage and generation creatures, six spells, cocoon storage, ascension and ten mutation categories.
An idle colony you can keep
Original insect artwork, analytic catch-up, keyboard and touch, clear purchase costs, backups and three isolated mods.
mods: Drones gather twice as much meat. Producer sacrifices and prices stay the same.
Double the real rate of passive larvae production.
Nexus generate energy five times faster; energy capacity and spell costs still apply.

bouncemasters.name: Bouncemasters
bouncemasters.summary: Timed bat swings · animal bumps · upgrades · endless flight route
bouncemasters.controls: Tap · click · Space · large flight action button

variants.kicker: A BEAR. A BAT. A BRAVE PENGUIN.
variants.title: One more bounce.
variants.copy: Drop from the ledge, time the bear's swing and keep your penguin flying with timed animal bumps.

variants.title: Seals. Walruses. Mammoths.
variants.copy: Collect coins, gems and chests while physics carries you across three original winter regions.

variants.title: Power. Speed. Rebound. Beat Force.
variants.copy: Four earned upgrade paths, a cumulative progress map, trophy rewards and a free daily gift.

variants.title: Choose your bat. Find your rhythm.
variants.copy: Five distinct bats, four penguin looks, classic or relaxed timing, practice and three downloadable mods.

features: Time the swing and the bump
Drop, bat and buffer a tap near a descending animal contact. Actual gravity, momentum, snow rebound and camera tracking.
A route with rewards
Three changing biomes, coins/gems/chests, four upgrades, cumulative trophy milestones and once-daily gifts.
Make it yours
Original bear, penguin and animal artwork. Earned bats/outfits, big touch input, keyboard, practice and three native mods.
mods: Lower gravity gives longer airtime. Landing targets still follow the actual trajectory.
Coins, gems and chests award twice their ordinary pickup currency.
A larger real collection radius pulls in nearby coins, gems and chests.
